original_target.title: Closed geodesics on complete manifolds of finite volume

scope_comparison: The new geodesic-net Main Theorem requires locally convex ends and yields a one-vertex multi-edge geodesic net, not a smooth periodic geodesic. The hyperbolic theorem requires hyperbolic geometry. Closed sphere/three-manifold results do not cover arbitrary complete finite-volume noncompact manifolds.
